turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Marcus. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I've just moved house and need to update my address. I'm worried it'll push my premium up, it's already so expensive.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, Margaret, that must be really stressful. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Margaret Hughes, 12 April 1978.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's KK1 3LA.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I should tell you I lost my job recently, so money is really tight at the moment.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I can refer you to our priority support team, who can look at options, and I'll confirm everything in writing so you have time to read it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've moved house and need your address updated. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And what's the new address, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 22 Maple Close.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, we may need to review the details, which can change your price slightly, and any difference is simply worked out for the part of the year that's left.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is my premium going to stay the same?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't confirm how it will affect your price, the system will recalculate it and you'll get it in writing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. The change takes effect straight away, your premium may be recalculated, and we'll send your updated policy documents within 3 working days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Margaret. I've updated your address under reference REQ-75145, and our policy services team will send the new documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've updated your address on the policy.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Margaret. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
